No Result View All Result Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us Hausa Edition Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us No Result View All Result No Result View All Result Tonto Dikeh Dedicates Church Building In Honour Of Jerry Eze by Ngozi Ibe 3 seconds ago in Entertainment Share on WhatsApp Share on Facebook Share on X Telegram Nollywood actress-turned-evangelist, Tonto Dikeh, has dedicated a church building in honour of Pastor Jerry Eze, founder of Streams of Joy International. Dikeh announced the development on Saturday, November 14, sharing photographs from the commissioning ceremony at the New Wine Prophetic Tabernacle, where she appeared in a red robe bearing the inscription “ELROI”. According to an inscription on the dedication plaque, the building was dedicated and commissioned by Dikeh in honour of Eze, under the leadership of Prophet Bala Jagaba. The plaque reads: “This church building is dedicated and commissioned by Evang. Tonto Dikeh in honour of Pst. Jerry Eze, under the leadership of Prophet Bala Jagaba, on this day, 14th November 2026.” The dedication follows Dikeh’s growing involvement in Christian ministry. In August, she unveiled the New Wine Prophetic Tabernacle Global, describing it as an interdenominational prayer and revival fellowship. In October, the actress also shared photographs and videos from the foundation-laying ceremony for the church building, accompanied by prayers and the anointing of building materials. At the time, she dedicated the project to God and expressed appreciation to Eze, whom she described as her spiritual father. “Thank you, PAPA, for your selfless leadership and for raising a generation of steadfast soldiers for the Kingdom. We love and honour you deeply,” she wrote. Eze is the founder of Streams of Joy International and the New Season Prophetic Prayers and Declarations (NSPPD), an online prayer movement with participants from different parts of the world. Dikeh, known for her roles in Nollywood films, has increasingly combined her entertainment career with Christian activities, sharing messages and testimonies about her faith on social media.
